api_scope.rationale: Story 35.2 changes semantic tokens, local font binding and the existing credential form presentation. The story expressly prohibits new endpoints, auth/session protocols and receipts; the High test design assigns deterministic login-state checks to the actual form caller seam and session/authority checks to existing real-cookie E2E, resolver unit and database integration suites. There is no story-owned API contract to scaffold. Creating endpoint tests merely to populate this worker template would invent scope.

existing_authority_and_reuse.role: Existing browser submission seam for delay, invalid credentials, rejection, explicit recovery, duplicate-attempt observation and refresh-before-replace assertions. These are caller/E2E responsibilities, not a new application endpoint.
Existing browser-safe public configuration and cookie-persistent Auth client remain the client boundary. No service-role client or new auth transport is introduced.

Existing server root resolves cookie-bound user/tenant authority and role landing after successful sign-in; ordinary server navigation/reload remains the reconciliation authority for an ambiguous outcome.
Existing protected layout rechecks server tenant context and shell access. Styling cannot grant access.
Reuse/extend real-cookie login and logout outcomes through the E2E worker; mocks alone cannot prove session issuance, server context or response-loss reconciliation.
Reuse existing server authority assertions; do not duplicate them as invented API tests.
Reuse existing database-backed authority assertions with required execution evidence during implementation verification.

utility_gates.playwright_utils_result: No generated API code or unresolved utility import; existing installed project patterns remain the fallback if applicable tests are later needed.
utility_gates.pact_mcp_probe_source: Parent tool-list probe; SmartBear MCP tools unavailable. Not probed again by this worker.
utility_gates.pact_fallback_source: Existing source seams and the approved Story 35.2 High test design, rather than broker provider states.
utility_gates.pact_result: No consumer/provider contract change and no installed Pact utility package; no Pact scaffold is applicable.

evidence_limits: Read the complete installed step-04a worker instructions, current story and High test design. Source seam details here are bound by those supplied documents; this worker did not execute or independently re-probe their runtime behavior.
No tests, browser actions, network/provider calls or resources were run. No functional, session, visual or acceptance pass is claimed.

Zero API scaffolds does not remove the story's seven AC and nine owned-state traceability bindings or required existing authority regressions; those remain assigned to their appropriate caller, E2E, source, asset and verification lanes.
summary: API/contract scaffolding is N/A for Story 35.2: zero endpoints or contracts introduced or changed, zero API tests and zero fixture needs. RED-phase worker output records bounded scope without inventing endpoint coverage.
